The problem

Most people spend months trying to furnish their apartment. Here is what that actually looks like.

01
The Design Problem
You scroll Pinterest for weeks. You save hundreds of posts. You cannot translate what you see into a real apartment. You don't know which styles work together, what fits, or where to begin.
02
The Sourcing Problem
Even if you find a design you love, you cannot source it. Different countries, different suppliers, different lead times. Some unavailable in UAE. Some are three times the price.
03
The Price Problem
The pieces you find locally are either too cheap and look it, or too expensive and break the budget. Quality at a reasonable price barely exists in the UAE mid-market.
04
The Time Problem
You have a job. You have a life. Going from showroom to showroom takes weekends. Months of weekends. Time you will never get back.
05
The Coordination Problem
Four suppliers. Three delivery windows. Two damaged items. One team that won't install until the other finishes. You become unpaid project manager of a job you never trained for.
06
The Result Problem
After all of that, the apartment still doesn't look like the Pinterest board. Because execution requires expertise, relationships and systems built over years.

If you can do all of the above, you should come work with us. Most people can't. That's exactly why Roooms exists.

We made every design decision so you don't have to. We built the supplier relationships so you don't need them. We manage the delivery and installation so you're free to do everything else. You choose a tier. We do the rest.

The solution

A team of designers. Years of supplier relationships. A proven system. All of it, yours.

Our designers studied what works, the trends that last, the pieces that function every day, the combinations that appeal to every taste and every culture. Badia was built to be beautiful for someone from Tokyo, comfortable for someone from London, and just as right for someone from Cairo.

Then we built the supply chain. Relationships with suppliers that give you quality no individual buyer can access at this price. An installation team that treats your apartment like their own. A system that means you get exactly what you see in the renders, every time.

"A team of designers. Years of supplier relationships. A proven system. All of it, for the price of doing it badly yourself."
